one_liner: ClickUp has a broad public REST API on all plans (including free) with personal tokens and OAuth2, plus an official remote MCP server (OAuth only).
auth_notes: Personal API token (pk_...) sent raw in Authorization header; OAuth2 authorization code flow for multi-user apps with Bearer token; access tokens currently don't expire. Workspace owners/admins create OAuth apps. The MCP server supports OAuth only, not API keys.
access_notes: API is available on all ClickUp plans. Some endpoints (user/guest management) are Enterprise-only; some parameters are limited by plan. Limited members with view-only permissions cannot access the API.
blocker_notes: Minor: some endpoints are Enterprise-only. The rate limit and no-API claims in the draft were not verified in the provided pages.

evidence.quote: For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.
Use a personal API token for individual or testing purposes. Personal tokens begin with `pk_`.
Our Public API is available on all [ClickUp Plans](https://clickup.com/pricing) . Some endpoints and parameters are limited by plan.
Anyone with a ClickUp account can generate a personal token.
The server works on every ClickUp plan, Free Forever included.
